name: C1 verifyMembership accepts ANY proof against ANY root
C2 leaves neither deduped nor sorted (root depends on input order)
C3 child discloses the LARGEST covering band, not the smallest
from: const covering = (attestations || []).filter((a) => a.band >= req).sort((a, b) => a.band - b.band);
to: const covering = (attestations || []).filter((a) => a.band >= req).sort((a, b) => b.band - a.band);

name: C4 REQ_ABOVE_BAND check removed (a $50 band authorises $51)
from: if (!(req <= attestation.band)) return { ok: false, reason: 'REQ_ABOVE_BAND' };

name: C5 band root binding removed (a band lifts onto another grant)
from: if (attestation.root !== root) return { ok: false, reason: 'BAND_WRONG_ROOT' };

name: C7 off-ladder parent band accepted (the 1e9 widening returns)
from: if (!ladderSet.has(a.band)) return { ok: false, reason: 'OFF_LADDER_PARENT_BAND', band: a.band };
to: if (false) return { ok: false, reason: 'OFF_LADDER_PARENT_BAND', band: a.band };

name: C8 leaf domain separator changed 'cap|' -> 'cap:' (verifier would disagree)
C9 node domain separator changed in buildTree 'node|' -> 'node:'
C10 verifyMembership ignores the sibling side (always sibling|h)
from: h = step.right ? H('node|' + h + '|' + step.hash) : H('node|' + step.hash + '|' + h);

name: C11 membershipProof for a cap NOT in the set builds a proof from index 0 instead of refusing
C12 reCommit lets the child sign EVERY ladder band (limit widens)
C13 duplicate parent band accepted
from: if (seenBands.has(a.band)) return { ok: false, reason: 'DUPLICATE_PARENT_BAND', band: a.band };
to: if (false) return { ok: false, reason: 'DUPLICATE_PARENT_BAND', band: a.band };

name: C14 verifyAttenuation accepts ZERO proofs as ok
C15 parent attests bands ABOVE its own limit (limit*2)
C16 BOUNDARY: a band exactly equal to the limit is no longer attested (<= became <)
C17 NO_VERIFIED_PARENT_BANDS refusal removed (a child re-commits from zero bands)
